reason: Primary arXiv HTML, sections 1, 3–5: depth recurrence and input reshaping for SSMs are evaluated on time-series classification datasets; parameter-shared depth variants use up to 1/L parameters and input reshaping adds 1–6% accuracy. The paper notes SSM efficiency motivation but evaluates time-series classifiers, not language-model inference, and supplies no LLM serving/latency result. Transfer to language SSM architecture is plausible but unestablished.
title: Reshape and Recur: Improving SSMs with Input Reshaping and Depth Recurrence
